en:
Hehe. I'm just getting warmed up. Wait till you see what I
do next!

The showdown between these two young idols continues! Next
up is the concert event!
Are you ready? Then, without further ado, let's get started!

Hmm. You looked a little out of your usual element up there,
Haruka-chan. Maybe you were a little thrown off?

But now that you've warmed up, you'll have another chance to
show us your skills in the next category.

You weren't bad, but you still didn't do as well as I
thought. The Princess League must not be as great as
everybody says, if that's all it takes.
I'm just getting warmed up.

So I can expect more in the next round, is that it? Good.
I'm looking forward to it.

Today on SBR99, we have Haruka Sawamura-chan of Princess
League fame joining us for the first time, so get ready for
an exciting battle!

Going up against Haruka is SBR99's own ace, Ayumi Domoto, in
an intense head-to-head competition!

As always, the audience will vote as the idols compete in
three categories: a dance battle, a concert event, and a
handshake event.

Now then, without further ado, it's time for Sotenbori
Battle Royale 99!
We'll start with the dance battle! Good luck to our competitors!
(It's sort of shady. I shouldn't go in.)
(They're closed today.)
(This is the ramen stall the chief took me to. Maybe I should stop in? It doesn't look all that busy.)

In Premium Adventure mode, your PrintCircle Books are combined into one book with six pages. Each playable character⑬Kiryu, Saejima, Haruka, Akiyama, Shinada, and Kiryu and Haruka together⑬has their own page.
You got a <Color:8>PrintCircle Book<Color:Default>.
Want to try the PrintCircle photo booth? The snow festival frame is lovely! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
(PrintCircle photo booth, huh? 400 yen for a session. Maybe we should take some pics?)
That was a lotta fun! Gimme a call again anytime, okay? <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
What? You called me all the way out here and now we're not even going to take pictures? I should have just stayed home in bed.
That was so much fun! Please give me a call again, anytime! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Oh, I don't think we did a very good job...
What's the meaning of this? You made me come out here, and we're not taking any pictures?
Oh, those came out awesome!
(A photo booth, huh? 400 yen for a session. Maybe we should take some pics?)

Sorry to keep ya waitin'! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
So, you wanted to do the photo booth with me, Kiryu-san?
Come on, I was in Tokyo! And you had to call me back to Sapporo for this?
There are frames they only got in Sapporo. I didn't have any other choice.
Sorry for the wait! This was just kinda sudden, Akiyama-san. So, you wanna take some photo booth pics with me, huh?
(Maybe I should give Shion a call.)
Hehe,<Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default> yeah. Well, wanna get started?

Once a customer places an order, Kiryu must cook the noodles to the requested consistency. They will gradually soften as they cook.
Serve the ramen by pressing the indicated button when the Consistency Gauge matches the order.

The pace of customer orders increases in stages as you successfully fill them. You won't proceed to the next stage if you botch too many.
Up to one hundred customers will place orders. Aim for the title of Ramen King!
(Doesn't look like they're using this one right now...)
Yeah, let's do that again.
(There it is.)
(From this distance, nothing looks amiss except for the light. I'd better check the interior.)
(They sped off as soon as I got close. Did they know I was here to help?)
(Seems like they headed north. All right, time to go after them!)
(Damn. I lost sight of them.)
Talk about dangerous. These taxis are out of control!
Yipes! Er, I mean... What happened is, I just about got flattened by a taxi. Guy was driving like a maniac!
Was the light on the taxi flashing red?
Actually, it was.
I caught a glimpse of the driver, and he had a look on his face like he'd seen a ghost. Maybe he had an impatient passenger.
(He looked like he'd seen a ghost, huh? Then it must have been some kind of emergency.)
Do you know which way the taxi went?
It was headed towards Suzukake Lane, I think.
Suzukake Lane. Got it. Thanks, you've been a big help.
(I'd better hurry. That driver's in trouble!)
(Found it!)
Hey, wait! What gives?
Huh? Oh, it's just that the driver is a friend of mine. I called out when I saw him, but he was acting real strange.
He looked really spooked. He mumbled something about yakuza.
(Yakuza? Maybe his passenger?)
Then he glanced up at his rearview mirror, and sped off all of a sudden. It's weird.
(Must have been threatened from the back seat.)
Did you see his passenger?
No, I didn't look in the back. You think he's caught up in some kind of trouble?
Which way did the taxi go?
Straight on ahead.
(That's towards Fukuhaku Street.)

Ooagh...! Guess that's what I get for pickin' a fight with a
yakuza.
You're the yakuza. I'm just an ordinary civilian.
What? I'm the civilian here.
You mean you're not the angry yakuza passenger?

What the hell does that mean? Do I look like yakuza to you?
I hate those money-grubbing, finger-chopping assholes!
Wait... Are you the driver?
What in tarnation are you rambling about!? <Italic>Of course</Italic> I'm the driver!
Then why aren't you wearing a uniform?
Hey, I was on break. What's the point of being all buttoned-up for that?
True... So you weren't getting robbed?
Robbed? Who was getting robbed?
I thought a passenger was threatening you, and that's why you were driving erratically.
Why on earth would you think that? I was just taking a nap when some yakuza type tried to get in the car, so I drove off.
I've had a lotta nasty trouble whenever those folks try to hitch a ride, and I'll be damned if I let it happen again!
But the guy today just kept chasing after me. I thought he was crazy or something.
This yakuza... Are you saying...?
...Is that why you flashed the emergency light?
See for yourself.
Oh, whoops. Must've hit the switch while I was napping again. I tend to toss and turn. I'm a side sleeper, y'see.
Well, sorry about that! I didn't take you for one of us. I'm allergic to yakuza, so I thought I had a pretty good instinct for spotting them.
This is the first time my gut has been wrong. I'm really ashamed I thought so badly of a fellow driver.
Just be careful not to trip that switch by accident again.
I don't know what to say. I've never had someone go to so much trouble to help me out before.
You're right. Taxi drivers may be rivals, but we've got to look out for each other.
Those are damn good words to live by! Anyway, thanks. Take this for your trouble.
Okay, I'd better get back to work.
(Isn't that...?)
(The taxi with the emergency signal on!)
(Nobody's in there... I guess I was too late. Where'd the driver and that yakuza go?)
All right, I know ya been followin' me. What is it ya want?
So you're the one behind this. Nice of you to come straight to me. Now what did you do with the driver?
Huh? You're not making any damn sense. But if you've come lookin' for trouble, you found it! You better skedaddle, or else!
Not happening. Taxi drivers may be rivals, but we've got to look out for each other!
Welcome. It's 800 yen to use the recreation room.
Uncle Kaz! Let's play <Color:8>air hockey<Color:Default> together!
(Haruka wants to play <Color:8>air hockey<Color:Default> with me.)
What will it be, sir?
An air hockey match is won by being the first to reach 9 points.

A long rally will build your <Color:255,200,200,255>Heat Gauge<Color:Default>.
A full gauge will let you deliver a <Color:255,200,200,255>Heat Smash<Color:Default>.
Use this when you've got the right opening!

Hold <Action:Button_R2@Air_Hockey> while the Heat Gauge is full to focus and slow down time.
Note that this <Color:255,200,200,255>Slow Mode<Color:Default> depletes the Heat Gauge, so use it wisely.

Hold <Action:Button_L2@Air_Hockey> to enter <Color:255,200,200,255>Staring Mode<Color:Default>, and stare at your opponent to build up your Heat Gauge.
While this does increase your Heat Gauge, the game does not stop, so be very careful!
I'm not gonna lose to you, Uncle Kaz!
We'll see about that.
Aww. Guess we'll have to have an <Color:8>air hockey<Color:Default> showdown some other time.
You'd like to use the recreation room? Have a pleasant time!
Welcome. It'll be 2,400 yen for the two of you to bathe and use the recreation room.
Let's take a quick dip in the hot spring! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
(Hinata wants to go in the hot spring.)

Hold <Action:Button_L2@Air_Hockey> to enter <Color:255,200,200,255>Staring Mode<Color:Default>. Stare at the girl's cleavage to build up your Heat Gauge.
The game does not stop during this mode, so be very careful!
Thank you very much. Have a good time.
Welcome. It'll be 800 yen to bathe or to use the recreation room, or 1,200 yen for both.
In Premium Adventure, Kiryu can play air hockey against Haruka at Yunosono Hot Springs.
While playing against Haruka, you cannot use Staring Mode or Heat Smash, so be sure to bring your A game!
Sure, let's do it.
(Should I invite Haruka?)
The hot spring it is. Thank you very much. Have a good time.
The recreation room it is. Thank you very much. Have a good time.
The combination package. Excellent choice. Have a good time.
It'll be 2,400 yen for two bathing and recreation room packages, sir.
Y'gotta be kiddin' me! Y'called me all the way out to Tokyo jus' to go to a hot spring!?
Right. It'll be relaxing for you.
Sorry to keep y'waiting! Ya wanted to hit up the hot springs with me, Kiryu-san? Too bad it ain't co-ed! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
All right, let's go in.
I figured you'd be cold up in Sapporo. The hot springs will help ya warm up.
Sorry to keep you! But I gotta say, it's rather bold of you to ask for this sort of thing, Saejima-san. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Ya wanna go in or not?
Ya called up a student who's busy lookin' for a job all the way out in Osaka, just to bathe in a hot spring that's not even co-ed? This some kinda joke?
Sorry to keep ya! You sure picked the right time of year to hit the hot springs, Akiyama-san. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Then let's go in.
Apologies for the delay! I hear it's good for one's complexion to bathe in a hot spring every once in a while! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
I can't believe I'm gonna be in the same hot spring as you, Shion-chan. Oh, boy.
Sorry to keep you waiting! Whoa, wait a sec, Kiryu-san. This isn't a co-ed hot spring, is it?
I guess we'll find out.
It's all right. Shall we get started?
Ahhh. The water feels nice.
Ohhh, nothing beats a good, hot bath. I usually just shower, so this is such a treat.
My word, Shinada-san. You sound like an old man.
Hey, you and me both, Shion-chan. Besides, aren't you at the age where you need to start worrying about your skin?
Hehe. Oh, don't worry. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default> I'm still growing, as it turns out. My chest got even bigger again. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Oh, I... I see.
(Shion-chan's breasts are still growing!?)
Nah, I'm still young, right? Young enough that you can't be mad at me for sneaking into the women's bath.
Hehehe. You'd have to be an actual child for that to be true. You'll get arrested if you try to do it, Shinada-san. Better watch yourself! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Aww, come on.
(Still, I can't say I'd never "accidentally" barge into the women's bath while you were in there, Shion-chan!)
Shinada-san, are you still there?
Yeah, uh-huh! You ready to get out soon?
Oh, I needed a good bath, all right. Feels like it's cleansing my body and spirit.
I love hot springs, too! I've been wantin' to go for a while, now!
In that case, we should bathe together. Build on our mutual appreciation of bathing, you know?
Oh, I know exactly what it is ya want to appreciate, Akiyama-san!
Ah! You've seen through me, and foiled my master plan! Alas!
(Man, a bath with Honoka-chan sure would be nice, though.)
Maybe you should be a hot spring reporter then. Report the news from inside a spring! That'd be something.
